notes:
### Fixes

- Takes over what 0.5.5 published to iCloud the first time it starts, so those records still expire on time and go away when you turn Agent HUD Remote off. If you run 0.6.0-beta.1, this beta catches up.
- Shows again on the iPhone where each session runs, the CLI, the desktop app or an IDE, instead of only the agent's name, and lets you filter by it.
- Stops the iPhone from showing token and cost totals as complete while the Mac is still reading your agents' logs.
- Lets only one copy of Agent HUD collect into the same data at a time: a second copy, such as a build of agent-hud-open, is refused while the first one runs.
